in_marathi.name: Divisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Desire, Wish, Ambition
in_marathi.long_meaning: Divisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Divisha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘divya’, meaning divine, celestial, or divine inspiration. The name is associated with the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, learning, and wisdom. Divisha signifies a strong desire, wish, or ambition, driven by the divine inspiration within.
